summary: STOIC iter25l full regression. 23 NEW backend tests (test_iter25l_full_regression.py) all pass; combined with the existing 46 iter25 tests = 69/69 backend tests passing. Frontend Dashboard renders all 4 of the 5 requested strips correctly (BotHealthScore, EaVersionStrip, QuickActionsBar with PANIC modal, quick-toggle-bot). OnboardingBanner is absent for admin (expected — onboarding complete). Bot Config page renders the full PositionSizingPreview with all 8 rows (55-90%), XAUUSD/BTCUSD switcher, and max-lot-size-input — but ONLY when navigated via the sidebar (which routes to /bot). Direct navigation to /bot-config returns a blank page (SPA route mismatch). Trades page no longer has BACKFILL button, REVIVE buttons appear for eligible trades. Notifications page shows the new Manual Trade Detected (external_trade_opened) row. WebSocket /ws accepts authenticated connect. Logout works.

ui_bugs.issue: Direct GET /bot-config returns a blank page (only 'Made with Emergent' badge renders). Sidebar link uses /bot which works. Likely missing route alias in React Router. Either the review_request URL is stale or an alias <Route path='/bot-config' element={<Navigate to='/bot' replace/>}/> is missing.

issues: Console emits two recharts warnings about width(-1)/height(-1) of chart container — non-blocking but should set minWidth/minHeight or aspect on ResponsiveContainer wrapper.

action_items: Add a React Router alias for /bot-config -> /bot (or rename the existing /bot route to /bot-config) so the spec'd URL works on direct navigation and browser-back.
Suppress or fix the recharts ResponsiveContainer width(-1)/height(-1) warning on the dashboard.
(Doc cleanup) The review_request lists endpoint /api/notifications/prefs but the implementation exposes /api/notifications/telegram. Either add a thin alias or update the spec/docs.
critical_code_review_comments: test_iter25c_account_aware_sizing.py and test_iter25d_max_lot_kelly_peak.py import top-level modules (from risk import …) — they only collect when PYTHONPATH=/app/backend or when run from inside /app/backend. Recommend prefixing imports with 'backend.' or adding a conftest sys.path tweak.

/api/bridge/heartbeat now derives open_tickets from positions when the legacy field is omitted (line 104 of bridge_routes.py). The stale-ticket guard (line 124) compares ea_positions_count<len(tickets) — but ea_positions_count is taken from payload.open_positions which is OPTIONAL. If the EA omits open_positions but sends positions[], the guard is silently skipped (ea_positions_count is None). Worth documenting that open_positions+positions must both be sent for the v1.26 guarantee to hold.

Account delete returns 400 unless ?force=true when non-terminal trades exist. The test failure mode was hard to debug (test left two orphan accounts hitting the 3-per-broker cap). Consider exposing an admin-only batch cleanup endpoint for test accounts (label prefix 'iter*').

BotConfig.jsx is ~1100 lines (per grep) — way over the 700-line soft limit in code review guidelines. Recommend extracting PositionSizingPreview, RiskProfileCards, ProfitProtectionSuite into separate components.

success_rate.frontend: ~93% (1 routing bug, all widgets render via sidebar nav)

rca of the issue: Bot Config blank-page bug: AppLayout sidebar links to /bot, but the review spec + presumably any docs link to /bot-config. The React Router config defines a route for /bot but not /bot-config, so a direct GET on /bot-config falls through to the catch-all empty layout. Fix is a one-line <Route path='/bot-config' element={<Navigate to='/bot' replace/>}/> in App.jsx OR rename the route to /bot-config (preferred, since it's the documented path).
